# simple_case

<!-- Generated by xtask. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Summary:** Simplifies CASE expressions that only fill NULL values.

**Category:** `maintainability`

**Editor default:** `save`

**Default level:** `hint`

**Fixable:** yes

## Rationale

NULL-filling CASE expressions are clearer as COALESCE calls.

## Configuration

```toml
[lints]
simple_case = { level = "warn" }
```

### Options

No options.

## Notes

- The current implementation targets the common CASE ... IS NULL ... ELSE same-value pattern.

## Examples

**Anti-pattern:**

```sql
CASE WHEN x IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE x END
```

**Best practice:**

```sql
COALESCE(x, 0)
```
